The '''Torrad system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
It was the site of a combat mission undertaken by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Jeht flew a prototype [[Delta-6 Sprite-class starfighter|Delta-6 starfighter]] on that mission.
